text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Admin time dropped, but not to zero.** Reps saved about 4 hours a week on CRM updates. They still had to review every summary.

**2. Next-step clarity improved.** Action items were captured the same day, so follow-ups went out faster.

**3. Trust took time.** Customers asked about recording in the first call. Telling them upfront, in one sentence, ended the concern.

**4. Adoption followed managers.** Teams whose leads used the summaries in pipeline reviews stuck with it. The rest drifted.

The tool didn't make anyone a better seller. It gave them back time to be one.

What did your team learn from your first AI pilot?

*(Synthetic scenario; figures are illustrative.)*
